mapper.select: /*"selectBuyerMdAmCatalogList"*/ SELECT DECODE ( A.STATUS, 'D', '삭제', DECODE ( C.STATUS, 'D', '삭제', DECODE (A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'N', '승인', 'Y', '단종'))) AS STATUS_TEXT, A.IMGFILE_NAME AS IMGFILE_NAME, A.IMGFILE_DIR AS IMGFILE_DIR, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION_LOC, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = C.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, C.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION_LOC, C.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, C.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, C.BUYER AS BUYER, C.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ FROM ICOMBYIT A, ICOMBYCA B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE A.BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer}) AND A.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND A.PURCHASING_AGENT_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG NOT IN ('S', 'G', 'K') AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND A.CATEGORY_NO = B.STD_CATEG_ID AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND DECODE ( A.STATUS, 'D', '삭제', DECODE ( C.STATUS, 'D', '삭제', DECODE (A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'N', '승인', 'Y', '단종'))) = #{st_status_text} AND A.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_description_loc}||'%' AND A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_specification_loc}||'%' AND C.MAKER_NAME LIKE '%'||#{st_maker_name}||'%' AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_buyer_item_no}||'%' ORDER BY 4
